conclusion_scope: Bounded classification for WP-DW-05 only. No entry upgrades an untested capability into a public contract.

limitations.rationale: CITY completeness is domain/source-universe owned. DW-02 accepted its declared production-query universe without changing the generic seam; DW-05 does not generalize it to all CITY semantics.
PA losslessness is schema/source-oracle owned and accepted for PA-01..05 only.
DW-04 remains bounded to its frozen task/model/configuration universe and is not a general adoption or quality claim.
Effective Unity-state comparison needs accepted H1 observation/projection evidence and is not exercised by DW-05.
In-repository project references do not prove package/version distribution or fresh-repository consumption.
DW has no accepted effort/cost authority; design-shape facts cannot be converted into cost estimates without a reviewed model.
Geometry, route clearance and authored Unity conformance are not Design World source-projection guarantees.
Design-implied content shape does not establish actual source-catalogue coverage.
Future accepted PA material may require projection/schema extension without implying the generic fact/relation/provenance seam failed.
DW-04 was a bounded fail-closed conformance trial, not a population estimate.
CITY, PA and one neutral synthetic graph are insufficient evidence for arbitrary-domain universality.
Generating production briefs from design queries is an unexercised downstream capability.
Replay-backed QA needs a separately accepted replay/evidence boundary.
Narrative knowledge validation requires a separately reviewed knowledge model and oracle.
CITY and PA providers are co-located with generic Arkus.DesignWorld, but the neutral path and generic public seam do not require their symbols. Packaging composition remains later work.
Arkus.DesignWorld.csproj retains warning suppression described as temporary during DW-03. The neutral probe does not require it and DW-05 does not clean it merely to improve optics.
A structurally valid graph can omit a domain-required relation; semantic necessity/cardinality remains independently owned by the consumer rather than inferred by H0.

AnchoredTextAuthorityReader consumes explicit definitions and an independent universe instead of discovering arbitrary document semantics. Source-specific adapter glue is expected and did not require a new shared abstraction for the neutral probe.
Whole-document digest binding can stale an otherwise unchanged anchor after an unrelated source edit. This is fail-closed over-invalidation, not a false-valid provenance path.
Typed DW payload remains in the generic extension envelope rather than becoming a new H0 canonical domain type. This is intentional isolation unless future evidence proves the seam insufficient.
Accepted CITY Markdown schema changes deliberately fail closed and require reviewed adapter/manifest evolution.
Planning-time required access roles do not prove runtime schedules, permissions or current openness.
Out-of-universe relation targets fail at the inherited generic projector before a domain oracle receives a projection. This is accepted validation layering, not a missing semantic capability.
Normal UTF-8 and documented .NET string behavior are foundational trusted primitives, not a DW product guarantee.
Git/blob identity, cryptographic hashes, filesystem reads and normal runner behavior remain within the foundational trusted base.
A future CITY identity family beyond current loc.* / fam.* requires explicit reviewed query-contract adoption rather than silent classification.
District values are accepted source labels; DW does not establish a new canonical district ontology.
RD-1..RD-4-style traversal claims require realized runtime evidence and are deliberately not inferred from design projection.
PA prose outside the adopted manifest is authoritative and source-open but not first-class query data in v1.
Same-authority evidence/fixture links support navigation but do not individually assert proof attribution for every finding.
Projected PA semantics do not prove Unity/runtime implementation, persistence, performance or final runtime architecture.
The accepted PA v1 corpus has one reviewed domain, living-world. A future second domain requires reviewed extension rather than implicit classification.
DW-04 provider token/cost observations are diagnostic only and do not establish a universal token or cost-saving claim.
